summary: Tested bid email notification features. Found and FIXED 2 bugs in server.py where code used non-existent 'first_name' field instead of 'name' field from User model. All 14 tests passed after fix. Email functions (send_bid_placed_email, send_outbid_email) are properly implemented and correctly fall back to logging when SendGrid is not configured (MOCKED).

critical_code_review_comments: Email notification implementation is correct and well-structured
Both send_bid_placed_email and send_outbid_email properly fall back to logging when SendGrid is not configured
Email calls are wrapped in try-except blocks ensuring bids succeed even if email fails (non-blocking)
Email templates include all required fields: listing title, bid amounts, auction end date, links, status indicators
